definitions.explanation: A duration of six months. The standard expression for a half-year period.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}{期間|きかん}は{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}だ。
examples.english: The study-abroad period is six months.

examples.japanese: あれから{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}が{経|た}った。
examples.english: Six months have passed since then.

examples.japanese: {試用期間|しようきかん}の{六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}を{無事|ぶじ}に{終|お}え、{正社員|せいしゃいん}として{採用|さいよう}された。
examples.english: Having completed the six-month trial period without issue, I was hired as a permanent employee.

notes:
{六|ろく} (six) + ヶ{月|げつ} (months counter), with sokuon assimilation to ろっ before か.

WRITING VARIANTS:
The middle character can be written as ヶ, ヵ, か, カ, or {箇|か} — all read か:
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ} (most common in print)
- {六|ろっ}{箇月|かげつ} (formal/legal)
- {六|ろっ}か{月|げつ} (informal)

The small ヶ is the standard learner-facing form. Note that this ヶ is not a katakana 'ke' but an abbreviation of {箇|か}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}{間|かん}: for a six-month period
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}{前|まえ}: six months ago
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}{後|ご}: six months later
- {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ}{以内|いない}: within six months

RELATED WORDS:
- {半年|はんとし}: half a year — equivalent in duration, more idiomatic in casual speech
- {三|さん}ヶ{月|げつ}: three months
- {十二|じゅうに}ヶ{月|げつ}: twelve months
